answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint many keys that vote as if independent but share one operator clock. Mechanism: force each claim through a prism of three staggered work digests: at T0 lock 1.81 POA, at T0+11m publish digest A bound to a random peer tip, at T0+23m digest B that must hash A||tip||slot. Only then an anchor seal of 5 peer countersigns opens a 90-second juniper window to finalize. Cost: N clones need N×1.81 POA plus N distinct tip chains. Verification: graders recompute A→B linkage and reject reused tips. Failure: late juniper window or mismatched digests burn the lock and score 0.
